assets/fonts/enclosed-pua-metrics.json.about: Where the box and the digit or letter inside it lie for the enclosed characters of HWP documents: bounding boxes in font units, measured by rhwp. No outline of any font is in it; it names the face the boxes were measured against.
assets/fonts/enclosed-pua-metrics.json.origin: rhwp's own data (assets/fonts/enclosed-pua-metrics.json), the same file rhwp builds into the WebAssembly of @rhwp/core.
